lead.headline: Tuten out of the FLEX before Thursday
lead.deck: Two missed practices and a Thursday lock; Taylor on the trade block; Pitts out, Marks in overnight.
lead.body: The bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten, in the FLEX, missed Monday's and Tuesday's practices with the ankle and foot and locks into that slot when Jacksonville kick off at Baltimore Thursday at 19:15. Gordon projects 16.5 to his 15.4 — a coin flip the projection takes, and the practice reports point the same way. Jonathan Taylor is in active trade talks before the NFL's 10 Nov deadline, and Josh Jacobs faces new allegations with no league action yet. This morning the owner dropped Kyle Pitts for Woody Marks as a free agent, so no priority was spent. Three coin-flip swaps are still unset: Gordon, Rice and Likely in, Tuten, Wilson and Loveland out.
